messages:
Sam: hey all — new hire here, trying to docker pull our internal image while on company VPN from WSL2 on Windows. pull just hangs at 'Downloading fs layer' for a long time and then times out. curl to registry returns 502 sometimes. Anyone seen this? I'm in us-west. /cc @alex

Alex I.: welcome Sam! try `docker --context`? but first, does `curl -v https://registry.internal.company.com/v2/` respond?

Sam: curl hangs, here's output:
```
* TCP_NODELAY set
* Connected to registry.internal.company.com (10.10.5.12) port 443
> GET /v2/ HTTP/1.1
< HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
```

Sam: if i disconnect VPN it works fine (resolves to public IP). so feels like split-tunnel / internal path issue

Maria (infra): yup likely internal path to registry goes through firewall that drops certain large pulls. Can you share output of `ip route` and `cat /etc/resolv.conf` from WSL?

Sam: pasted below
```
$ ip route
default via 172.20.10.1 dev eth0
172.20.0.0/16 dev eth0 proto kernel scope link src 172.20.12.34
10.10.0.0/16 via 172.20.10.1 dev eth0
$ cat /etc/resolv.conf
nameserver 172.20.10.2
search corp.redwood
```

Alex I.: hmm registry resolves to 10.10.5.12 which routes over VPN. Can you try `curl --interface 172.20.12.34 https://registry.internal.company.com/v2/`? Also check Windows side VPN split-tunnel settings — sometimes DNS is pushed but route priorities are wrong.

Sam: tried curl with interface, same 502. On Windows netstat shows connstate CLOSE_WAIT on many tcp connections to 10.10.5.12

InfraBot: ticket #INC-4432 created to track internal registry path; assign:maria; priority:high

Maria (infra): thanks infra bot. Sam — can you test adding a host override in WSL `/etc/hosts` to the public IP as a quick workaround? If that works we can update split-tunnel or create NAT rule.

Sam: overriding to public IP worked, images pull fine now. not ideal but ok for today :relieved:

Ben (DevEx): welcome! we'll follow up with a proper fix. For future new hires on Windows + WSL we add docs: 'if internal registry times out, try host override or ask infra to check firewall conntrack' — assigning doc to me.

Alex I.: FYI infra will check firewall and conntracking, might need to exempt registry subnet from deep inspection. @Sam i'll DM for VPN client logs.

Sam: thanks everyone! really appreciate the speed :thumbsup:
